meta.description: Spike (#72): pulls a leaf blade over a vein network. The veins lie in the horizontal plane, the thickness of a vein is how far the blade reaches around it, and their height bends the blade. The leaf is placed like the one of the leaf node: it grows along -z from its base and faces up.

veins.description: The veins, made with stem, rotate, points_on_path and branch_from_points.

size.description: 1 makes 1 m of vein as long as the leaf of the leaf node.

smooth.description: How far the blade fills in between the veins. 0 leaves a lobe or a tooth at every vein, more makes a smoother margin.

margin.description: How far the margin is cut in, read with alpha going along the margin from the base (0) to the tip (1) on both sides. A wave cuts teeth, a curve lobes.

relief.description: How deep the veins lie in the blade.

method.description: Field meshes the union of the veins, hull the outline around them seen from the middle of the leaf.
